newsitem.title: USA: Central and South West monitors div policy.
newsitem.headline: Central and South West monitors div policy.

text.p: Central and South West Corp, which declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.435 a share, said on Thursday that it is monitoring regulatory and legislative factors that could affect its dividend policy.

The dividend will continue to be reviewed quarterly by the company's board of directors and the company's financial condition, earnings and strategic plans will be factors in the company's dividend plans, the company said in a statement.
The dividend is payable on August 29, 1997, to shareholders of record on August 8, 1997.
